actionable_steps.citation: God, man and the Cosmos — SSS Vol 28 (1995), 1995-04-14
actionable_steps.step: Love God for His own sake — drop the habit of praying only for favours and fulfilled desires.

actionable_steps.citation: From love : to love — SSS Vol 22 (1989), 1989-03-06
actionable_steps.step: Keep love for the Divine alive in every situation, not only in the prayer room — devotion must transcend time, place and circumstance.

actionable_steps.citation: The Power of Divine Love — SSS Vol 28 (1995), 1995-01-14
actionable_steps.step: Root out attachment, hatred and envy from your heart; devotion cannot go near a heart filled with them.

actionable_steps.citation: From love : to love — SSS Vol 22 (1989), 1989-03-06
actionable_steps.step: Offer all your thoughts and actions to God through the day, yearning for His grace like a child crying for its mother.

actionable_steps.citation: Make adoption meaningful to villagers — SSS Vol 17 (1984), 1984-05-20
actionable_steps.step: Show that love to everyone you meet and in everything you do — wholehearted love for God flows outward as love for all.

definition.citation: Devotion is pure love for God — SSS Vol 27 (1994), 1994-08-21
definition.quote: The true mark of devotion is pure love of God. Without this pure love, bhajans, worship and the like are artificial exercises and are valueless.

discourses.citation: Devotion Is The Panacea — SSS Vol 21 (1988), 1988-09-15
discourses.quote: Devotion bestows the highest benefits. Devotion alone is the means to Realisation. Devotion alone confers Supreme peace. Devotion is the panacea for all ills.

discourses.citation: From love : to love — SSS Vol 22 (1989), 1989-03-06
discourses.quote: Bhakti has been described as the state of non-separation from God. Regardless of time, space or circumstance, one should feel closeness to God - that is true Bhakti.

discourses.citation: The Lord and the Devotee — SSS Vol 19 (1986), 1986-08-27
discourses.quote: True devotion stems from the consciousness that jivatma (the individual soul) is a spark of the Divine.

discourses.citation: Devotion is pure love for God — SSS Vol 27 (1994), 1994-08-21
discourses.quote: True devotion knows no differences. It sees unity in diversity.

make_it_real: Devotion is not a performance for God — it is love that refuses to leave His side, in grief and in joy.
title: Devotion (Bhakti)

vahinis.quote: There is no distinction between devotion to God (bhakthi) and spiritual wisdom (jnana)... Dedicated activity is devotion and devotion is spiritual wisdom.
The devotee can tie up the Lord with love, by devotion that overwhelms and overpowers egotism. When one is full of this type of devotion, the Lord Himself will bless one with everything one needs.
